entities.summary: Ryker Garth Evans is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Seattle Kraken of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected with the 35th overall pick by the Kraken in the 2021 NHL Entry Draft. He previously played with the Regina Pats of the Western Hockey League (WHL).
